extracted.intended_audience: readers of literary news, writers, editors, and general book-lovers interested in the Best American series
extracted.subtask_description: Announcing and describing the guest-editor-driven selection process for the Best American anthology volumes, including which genres are covered and the roles of series and guest editors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Series editor selection of notable works
rubrics_metrics.description: Each volume’s series editor selects notable works from hundreds of magazines, journals, and websites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This describes the initial curation step: the series editor surveys a broad range of publications to compile a longlist of notable pieces for consideration. No explicit quality criteria are provided beyond 'notable.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Guest editor final selection
rubrics_metrics.description: A special guest editor, a leading writer in the field, then chooses the very best pieces for the anthology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guest editor makes the final decisions about which pieces appear in the volume, selecting from the series editor’s notable works. The page emphasizes stature of the guest editor but does not enumerate specific evaluative criteria (e.g., originality, craft, theme).

rubrics_metrics.name: Genre and scope of each volume
rubrics_metrics.description: Each book in the annual series showcases the best short fiction and nonfiction in a given year, from short stories to essays, science and nature writing, to food writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the topical/genre remit for individual volumes — each volume focuses on a particular field (short stories, science fiction & fantasy, mystery & suspense, essays, food writing, science and nature writing, etc.) and collects the year's standout works within that remit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guest editor credentials/standing
rubrics_metrics.description: Guest editors are leading writers in the field (examples given: Pulitzer Prize winner, bestselling authors, award winners, widely published commentators).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implicit evaluative expectation: guest editors are chosen for recognized achievement and expertise, suggesting that editorial judgment is informed by professional stature and experience. The page lists biographies and honors for each guest editor as justification for their selection.
